name: VeriQloud
description: VeriQloud develops software and protocols for secure quantum communication networks, including quantum key distribution and cloud-based quantum computing access. The company contributes to the FranceQCI national quantum communication infrastructure project and offers HyQloud, a full-stack solution for hybrid classical-quantum cloud datacenters.
